تستقدرون (form X)
# تَسْتَقْدِرُونَ (tastaqdirūna) /tas.taq.di.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْدَرَ (istaqdara)
# تُسْتَقْدَرُونَ (tustaqdarūna) /tus.taq.da.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْدَرَ (istaqdara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
